notes.title: Release Date Confirmed!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576959/421ecc95bcb0f8c06d567463d3a4bcc6793b9dc1.png[/img]

Welcome back, curious minds!

[u][b]The moment we've all been waiting for has finally arrived![/b][/u]
I’m delighted to announce that Sani Yang’s Laboratory will officially open its doors on:

🗓️ September 29th (PDT)

You’ve been following our progress since the early days—through trials, demos, and research breakthroughs. Thanks to your support, the laboratory is now ready to welcome you properly. And I, for one, can’t wait to see you step inside.

Since our last encounter, my team and I have been refining every detail, adjusting every mechanism, and ensuring that your experience will be nothing short of unforgettable. Every corner of this laboratory has been prepared with care… just for you.

So, what comes next?
Mark the date. Ready your curiosity. And prepare to embark on this new chapter with us. The laboratory doors will swing wide open—and beyond them, discoveries await.

I’ll see you on September 29th. The laboratory is waiting… and so am I.

With anticipation,
— Professor Sani Yang

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576959/2e2a776492e345b338f024bb3010c5e528500cf8.png[/img]

Well, well... The moment we've been waiting for has arrived!
[u][b]Steam Next Fest is officially underway, and our laboratory is ready for curious visitors![/b][/u]

🎉 [b]Festival Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Started: June 9 at 10:00 PT
[*] Ends: June 16 at 10:00 PT
[*] Perfect timing to showcase what we've been working on!
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3502900

This Next Fest presents an absolutely golden opportunity for us to introduce more minds to our little corner of scientific wonder. There's nothing quite like having fresh eyes discover the mysteries we've been crafting!

So here's where I need your help, dear community—spread the word! Tell your friends, your family, that person you met at the coffee shop who mentioned they love puzzle games. The more people who discover our Demo during Next Fest, the better!

I'll be here in the lab, eagerly waiting to meet all the new faces who decide to step through our doors. Who knows? Maybe one of them will become our next regular researcher~!

Happy Next Fest, everyone!

notes.title: First Demo Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576959/9c076ffd40b492d895072c432eed550a2e7683ba.png[/img]

Hello again, curious minds!
[u][b]I've been hard at work making some important improvements to the lab![/b][/u]

Here's what I've fine-tuned for you:

🔧 [b]Major Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dimmed the lab lighting - Your eyes will thank you during those long research sessions!
[*] Fixed character display issues - Now all languages show their characters correctly
[*] Polished English text - Much smoother reading experience
[*] Completely refreshed Simplified Chinese - A thorough overhaul for better clarity
[/list]

Special thanks go to [b]L.C. and ⑨(ᗜˬᗜ)BAKA[/b] for their valuable feedback! Community input like yours helps make the lab a better place for everyone.

These updates should make your time in the laboratory much more comfortable. Keep exploring, and don't hesitate to share your thoughts—I'm always listening!

Happy researching~!

notes.title: The Sani Yang's Laboratory Demo is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576959/1cdbfcb5f02aea92db01e8bf16d41abecd6aba78.png[/img]

Well, well... Have you been waiting patiently?
[u][b]Because today’s the day—the Sani Yang's Laboratory demo is finally live![/b][/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3502900

In this demo, you'll get to explore up to the start of Act 2, uncovering ancient relics and oddities alongside my charming self, of course!

I can’t wait to see you inside the game!
And hey—if you like what you see, don’t forget to leave a review. Your words might just bring more curious minds into our lab.

Enjoy the demo—and stay tuned for the full release. I’ll be right here, tinkering with the next surprise~!

notes.title: Professor Sani Yang Finally Speaks!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576959/50e5fb1f4d0d208956348a9927ff7845d34cc4a0.jpg[/img]

Hi there! I'm Professor Sani Yang. Sani's my given name, and Yang's the family name! I'm the top therio researcher here. Ahem… Y-You can just call me Professor Sani~.

Our main field is Human World Antiquities—strange objects, long-lost stories, forgotten places. That’s what I dig into!
And you, yes you… you’ll get to experience it very soon. Ready to uncover a few secrets?

[b]🕑 May 26th, 02:00 PDT[/b]
[b]🔍 Sani Yang's Laboratory Demo Release[/b]

Be sure to stay tuned! You never know what surprises my experiments might bring.
I’ll be waiting in the lab—don’t be late!
